# `tests/fixtures/classify/`

Fixtures of the JEV trial's classifier collector (`src/cobalt/classify/`). No fixture here carries a key, an `Authorization` header or a bearer token (each checked by `grep -c` at write time, quoted in the build report).

- `openrouter-model-entry.real-shape.json` — `GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/typesafe/jev-1.13/endpoints`, the per-model endpoints record of his id (R42), written by `cobalt classify discover` to `scratch/openrouter-models-20260923.endpoints.json` and copied byte-identical (1076 bytes). Read by `tests/cobalt/test_classify_discover.py`. SHAPE: live capture of OpenRouter's public per-model endpoints record, 2026-09-23 11:23 ET, keyless.
- `openrouter-systemone-response.openapi-example.json` — one `POST /api/v1/systemone` response answering the `FLOOR` set (`trend_up`, a Noul). Built from the OpenAPI schema's own documented `200` example (desk R47; `scratch/docs-openrouter/submit-a-system-one-request.md`): the envelope (`id`, `model`, `provider`, `usage`) is copied from that example, and the answer is the example's own Noul answer (`{"noul": 0.96, "type": "noul"}`) placed under FLOOR's question id. It carries no probabilities and no confidence, because a documented Noul answer has neither. Matched by the `openrouter-*response*.json` glob of `tests/cobalt/test_classify_door.py`'s parametrized parse tests; build `31` adds `openrouter-probe-response.real-shape.json` beside it, and the same tests then run on both. SHAPE: OpenRouter OpenAPI example, not yet a live capture.
- `openrouter-probe-response.real-shape.json` — SHAPE: live capture of the one keyed probe, 20260923T212532 UTC, raw body, byte-identical (31)
- `openrouter-probe-s1.real-shape.json` — SHAPE: live capture of the S1 probe (one choice, one score, two noul), 20260923T215433 UTC, raw body, byte-identical (73)
- `systemone-openapi-example.json` — `{"request", "response"}`: the OpenAPI schema's documented request example (ticket triage, one Noul / Choice / Score) and its documented `200` example response, transcribed from the saved YAML into JSON with no value changed. Read by `test_classify_door.py` to show that the render matches the documented request field for field and that probabilities and confidence parse when returned. SHAPE: OpenRouter OpenAPI example, not yet a live capture.
